name: 针叶巡林
evolution: 松仔 → 松叶羊 Lv.16 → 针叶巡林 Lv.36
description: 丛林的向导，拥有修长的四肢与轻盈的骨骼结构，发育完全的角呈树枝状。“所谓的规则像是枝条，又好像荆棘。被缠上时使人烦躁，被刺伤时让人疼痛。但规则也有如树干，在支撑着森林的生命——所谓自由，亦是如此”。
descriptionEn: A guide of the jungle, with slender limbs and a light bone structure; its fully grown horns are branch-shaped. "Rules are like branches, yet also like thorns. When entangled they annoy; when stung they hurt. But rules are also like tree trunks, supporting the forest's life — such is freedom."
